errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the values for industry and construction in the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' chart. Industry is 19.0 million (61%), and construction is 2.4 million (8%) as shown in the image.

The description incorrectly swaps the values for industry and construction in the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' chart. Industry is 80.2 million (51%), and construction is 13.4 million (9%) as shown in the image.
The description incorrectly swaps the values for industry and services in the 'TURNOVER' chart. Industry is 9.8 trillion (31%), and services are 10.6 trillion (33%) as shown in the image.
The description does not explicitly state that the charts represent the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021.
The description does not mention that the charts include percentage labels alongside absolute values.
